correctness.rationale: Direct all-parameter clique dichotomy and explicit good-cover nerve argument yield Y_k homotopy equivalent to the circle. A root-of-unity map detects degree +1 for each exceptional triangle. Exact integer homology of the pair gives kernel of sum with no torsion, and oriented relative simplices give r(t_j)=t_(j+1), s(t_j)=-t_(-j). The complete character follows by counting fixed labels. A pure-Python exact face enumeration and signed simplicial Lefschetz computation confirm every one of 210 dihedral actions for k=2 through k=8; this finite cross-check is not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The closest directly relevant 2011 and 2014 full texts provide the nonequivariant wedge result and a k=3 attachment visualization, but not the integral dihedral action on H2 of the Rips complex for all k. The 2014 dihedral proposition concerns nerve complexes, while its Rips-to-nerve map changes the vertex count from 3k to 2k and does not intertwine the full rotation. Comparable indexed characters refer to different complexes. There remains a nonzero risk of an unindexed equivalent or a nonobvious implication from existing work.

value.rationale: The one-third winding threshold is a canonical first transition from circle-type to even-sphere-wedge Rips topology for equispaced points. Determining the entire integral D_(3k) lattice, C3 kernel, and parity-dependent reflections adds equivariant information omitted by the known homotopy rank; it is a natural infinite-parameter classification with a structural proof, not a selected finite table or cosmetic reparameterization.
